decision.basis: Bounded forward-state lifetime eliminates substantial repeated allocation and reduces diagram/alpha admitted peaks, with exact packets and full ownership/consumer checks. Independent CPU results are mixed and normalized comparisons inconclusive; adverse raw diagram regression retained. No retiming for favorable results.

design: Trace cost/pending/source arrays use min(N,8192) entries, preserving a full ushort[N] backtracking path. All forward accesses lie within[a-1,a+8188]; Literal(a) expires a-2 before its future alias can be touched. Long prices, absolute pending sources, future Resolve writes, search order/ties and selected token ownership remain unchanged. No new owner or pool.
